lines.beaver: 선배님, 진로 고민이 많아요. 조언 좀 해 주세요.
lines.beaver_en: Senior, I'm worried about my career. Please give me advice.
lines.beaver_roman: Seonbaenim, jillo gomini manayo. Joeon jom hae juseyo.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 옛날 진로 이야기부터 해 볼게요.
lines.en: Sure. Let me start with careers in the past.
lines.roman: Joayo. Yennal jillo iyagibuteo hae bolgeyo.

lines.beaver_en: What jobs were popular in the past?
lines.en: Back then, legal professionals were a symbol of success.

lines.beaver_en: I heard exams were the gateway to success.
lines.en: Right. The state exam was the gateway to success.

lines.learner: 예전엔 상인을 낮게 봤지만 지금은 달라요.
lines.en: Merchants were looked down on, but it's different now.
lines.roman: Yejeonen sangineul natge bwatjiman jigeumeun dallayo.

lines.en: Young people starting businesses are on the rise.
Schools that train professionals are increasing too.

lines.beaver_en: Are fewer people working in just one job?
lines.learner: 네, 한 분야에 평생 종사하는 사람은 줄었어요.
lines.en: Yes, fewer people work in one field for life.
lines.roman: Ne, han bunyae pyeongsaeng jongsahaneun sarameun jureosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Are there many people with side jobs too?
lines.learner: 네, 본업 외에 부업을 하는 사람이 늘고 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, more people have side jobs besides their main work.
lines.roman: Ne, boneop oee bueobeul haneun sarami neulgo isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 세상이 많이 변했네요. 저는 어떻게 하면 좋을까요?
lines.beaver_en: The world has really changed. What should I do?
lines.beaver_roman: Sesangi mani byeonhaenneyo. Jeoneun eotteoke hamyeon joeulkkayo?
lines.en: Things change fast, so don't be afraid and try.

lines.beaver_en: Thank you, senior. That helped a lot.
lines.en: You're welcome. Contact me anytime if you're curious.
